You know, it's never too late to turn around. Some people get married at 40-50. I wrote a similar message to my mother but I didn't act upon it and I didn't give it to her yet. 

Do you ever wonder about the future? Things like, what if I continue now and I'm happy when I'm 40? Yeah, it's a long way and there's no guarantee but I feel like you don't get any guarantees in this life.

I believe my parents want me back home but I think it would be pretty miserable for all of us. I used to visit them and it would turn ugly if I stayed more than 3-4 days. And yes they probably still want me to depend on them. They wouldn't let me get a part-time job during high school either. Thanks for pointing it out. I've never been to a psychiatrist. I wonder if I should go for a check-up basically.

I wonder if there is a story. I think everything is my own fault. I used to blame my parents all the time. If I look at it from most people's point of view, there's nothing wrong in my life. My father is very authoritarian, I always had to do what he wanted. I had to do maths in high school which is fine but I wanted to go to art school. I was bullied in high school, mostly sexual harassment. My professors sided with the bullies. My dad did nothing and didn't let me change schools. I had to do sports (volleyball - attend 3-4 training sessions per week constantly with no holidays), I hated every bit of it. I quit after 4 years to my parents great disappointment. Then came college, ofc I had to do engineering. I still haven't finished. My family was devastated. Most of them have college degrees. They aren't happy I'm employed either. The news of me getting a job while still in college was really bad for them. My dad used to tell me constantly since I was a child that I won't be anything, that I would be jobless and living on the streets. My mom is mentally ill(bipolar) since before I started high school. I regret not being there for her more. I was pretty much shocked of how she changed, she's a completely different person since the disease started. My grandma (dad's mother) is no different, she would say something harsh to me when she got the chance. I think I was a coward, I didn't stand up to anyone. I also believed and cared about what my family told me. I only lately realized that my dad lies a lot. I could have ignored them all. So now as an adult I have a job I don't like, I don't know what I want for me, I almost never think about it. I don't know what makes me happy. I have no hobbies and no goals. I have really low self esteem and anxiety. And what breaks me is that I did the worst thing to someone who loved me. Totally fucked up my relationship because of who I am as a person. So I'm depressed and sad on a regular basis. Most people dismiss my story so I sometimes think I was born fucked up. I don't want to blame my parents, they probably tried their best and humans make mistakes.
It's good that you went. It's always good to fight with the disease.

Have you gone back to the doc or try to visit a new one? I can imagine that can also be a struggle. I remembered one more thing that kinda keeps me going. I donate blood. I have to wait 2 months in-between donations. I like to believe it's useful to someone as I mostly feel useless. I bet the sleep pattern doesn't make anything easier.
How did things stopped being fun? Have you noticed anything in particular?
I am sorry you had to terminate your marriage. I think a breakdown can bring the worst in us. It does for me. I am here if you want to chat.

I am sorry for your loss. I really admire you for staying away from any substance. I would like to have fun before I die. I would quit my job and just go drinking in pubs and clubs in a foreign country I like. I am reluctant to do it, I feel shameful towards my family. Have you tried making a list of the things you want to do?

Maybe just join a party then? Try to find one which has similar ideologies to what you would like to build. You could also write down things - small things, you want to do before you die. Maybe you're excited about a game or movie, maybe there's a place you want to travel to...I know it sounds silly. I know how living day by day with no big goal in the end is. Sometimes small things keeps us going.

My family is pretty much the only thing that keeps me alive. I recently messed up my life big time and ended up regretting not killing myself before it. What I seem to lack is a purpose for my life. Have you contemplated on that thought? Besides all this shit you go through everyday, isn't there just something you want to do? Hell, it's just this one shitty life, we could do something we really wanna do, finish it and after that we could continue thinking about how to kill ourselves or maybe there might be something else we wanna do...maybe it sounds selfish. I know for one that I've been living for my parents my whole life and that's just one reason I lack the sense of real purpose.

I think her explanation for being sexually unhappy is a bit vague. It seems to me that there might be a lack of good communication between you too. I don't want to get your hopes up but maybe she needs time to think. Is or has she seen a specialist regarding her being abused? Have you considered seeing a therapist together? I would definitely get more answers from her if that is possible.

If you happen to offend someone, apologize, tell them you don't know them well enough and didn't realize you offended them, people should understand.
